t: The $(item)Creative Compressor/$ is a non-craftable $(l:base_concepts/pressure)air compressor/$.$(p)Simply select the desired pressure in the compressor's GUI, and it will maintain that pressure in all connected pipes and machines.
$(item)创造模式压缩机/$是一种无法合成的$(l:base_concepts/pressure)空气压缩机/$。$(p)只需在压缩机的 GUI 中选择所需压力，它就会在所有连接的管道和机器中维持该压力。
